title: Empagi Engulumivu ez’Ebifunvu Ebikulukutiddwa Empewo
intro: Teebereza embuga ekulaakulana efunye ekirabo ky’amaanyi amangi n’obukugu obutageraageranyizibwa mu kuzimba. Olw’okuba kyali kibeera wakati mu bifunfugu ebinene ennyo ebikoonagana, ekitundu kino kyasitula ebifo ebikulu eby’enjawulo ebyakwata ku bbanga. Naye amalala gaasimbye emirandira, era omulanga ogw’okudda mu kusinza Allah yekka gwasisinkana n’okujeemera. Ebyaddirira bisigala nga kulabula okutwalibwa ku mpewo yennyini.
clues: Twali ggwanga lya maanyi eryajja oluvannyuma lw’abantu b’e Nuu, nga tuweereddwa omukisa n’obuwanvu n’amaanyi amangi.
Twazimba eminaala egy’amaanyi n’ebijjukizo ku buli kifo ekigulumivu olw’emizannyo gyokka n’okwenyumirizaamu.
Twewaana, nga tugamba ani atusinga amaanyi mu maanyi, era ne tweyisa mu ngeri ey’obukambwe awatali kusaasira.
Twagaana omubaka waffe Hud bwe yatuyita okusinza Allah yekka, ng’amuyita munafu era mulimba.
Twasekerera okulabula ne tumusomooza atuleete ekibonerezo kye yatiisatiisa singa aba amazima.
Twasaanyizibwawo empewo ey’obusungu era etaliimu bimera okumala ekiro musanvu n’ennaku munaana, ne tulekebwa nga tugudde ng’ebikonge by’enkindu ebirimu ebituli.

arabic: قَالُوٓا۟ أَجِئْتَنَا لِتَأْفِكَنَا عَنْ ءَالِهَتِنَا فَأْتِنَا بِمَا تَعِدُنَآ إِن كُنتَ مِنَ ٱلصَّـٰدِقِينَ
verse: They said, "Have you come to delude us away from our gods? Then bring us what you promise us, if you should be of the truthful." (46:22)
